measurement: THE INSPECT-FIRST CONTROL SET (v2-i), complete — n = 11 distinct problems
the_reading: both priors LOSE ground against a baseline that simply looks first, and both localise MORE accurately than it (41.2% vs 38.8%). G-trivial reaches the same four problems and converts fewer episodes; G-trivial′ drops to three. Aim improves, outcome worsens, cost rises.
the_week_in_one_line: no experience-prior carrier tested in either field lowered cost with capability held. The only intervention that did both was a change to WHEN the agent may act — and it was hand-written, not learned.
bounds: n = 11, exact for greedy arms and a near-bound where EXPLORE_TEMP fires (split signatures listed per arm).
'Problems' counts signatures with at least one green episode; the POOLED rate is the finer measure once signatures split, and the two can move in opposite directions.
G-trivial is handed the TRUE bug_class; it is an oracle on region and class and still loses to looking first.
